items.title: Block Club South Side Health & Wellness Fest Celebrated Groups Working To Fix Health Disparities
items.description: With 70+ medical tests, three group workouts, and one day full of health and wellness resources, our neighborhood newsroom brought together 30+ community partners working toward a healthier South Side.

items.title: Gino & Marty’s Workers Still Owed Thousands As Former Owner Launched Projects In Dubai, Mexico
items.description: Former employees describe bounced paychecks, financial hardship and alleged threats as the restaurant’s owner disputes responsibility for its payroll problems — and said the restaurant’s staff culture was “lazy.”

items.title: Ald. Jason Ervin Faces 1 Challenger In 28th Ward Race
items.description: West Side native Precious Joy Frasier is vying to unseat the incumbent alderman as he seeks a fifth term, but she faces a challenge to her nominating petition.

items.title: Chicago Influencer Morgan Cook Talks Life After ‘Traitors’ — And Love For Lake Michigan
items.description: The Old Town resident joined the season five cast of the popular reality series, airing Thursdays on NBC/Peacock. And yes, she has heard enough about "fruitgate."

items.title: Angee Gonzalez Rodriguez Challenging Ald. Jessie Fuentes For 26th Ward Seat Again
items.description: Gonzalez Rodriguez, a longtime Humboldt Park resident, is running for a second time against Fuentes, who was elected in 2023.

items.title: Want To Get More Involved In Your Community? Free City Civics Day Can Show You How
items.description: The annual event will host panel discussions, a walking tour from the founder of Brick of Chicago, art activities and a free lunch at the Cultural Center Saturday.

items.title: Sunroom Space Brings Risograph Print Studio, Retail Shop To West Town
items.description: Clare Byrne and Jake Stolz have created an artistic outpost in West Town for their printing studio, record imprint and myriad other creative projects.

items.title: Avondale Rallies To Support Brothers Restaurant After Owner, Cook Attacked In Violent Break-In
items.description: The early Monday burglary followed one at Pretty Cool Ice Cream in Logan Square and comes amid a rash of break-ins targeting small businesses across the city.
